description: Δήμος Νάξου και Μικρών Κυκλάδων: pipeline datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δήμος Νάξου και Μικρών Κυκλάδων. Coverage: Δήμος Νάξου και Μικρών Κυκλάδων. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about pipeline; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Υψόμετρα αγωγού ΒΙΟΚΑ; Εκροή Αγωγών Επεξεργασμένων Λυμάτων; Αγωγός λυμάτων ΒΙΟ.ΚΑ. Formats seen: WMS, SHAPE-ZIP, XML, CSV, GEOJSON. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
